reason: This plugin is best classified as an agent workflow orchestration plugin: the README positions it as a DeepSeek Harness sidebar map for linking Requests, Agents, Plans, and Reviews to run real tasks, while the package metadata shows DSH plugin integration and tool/agent-related runtime dependencies. It is mainly a visual orchestration interface with execution governance and reporting rather than a utility or generation-only plugin.

summaries.zh: Knotline 是 DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏插件，通过可视化画布连接请求、智能体和执行节点，帮助用户编排任务流程、触发任务执行并查看过程与结果。
summaries.en: Knotline is a DeepSeek Harness sidebar plugin that lets you visually connect requests, agents, and execution nodes to orchestrate workflows, trigger task runs, and review run results in one interface.

capabilities: Task lifecycle visualization and status tracking
Task backlog and scheduled trigger support
Use of host-provided DSH agent/tool capabilities

reasons.code: README: describes a canvas workflow where connecting a Request to an Agent runs real DSH execution with live transcript, plans, reviews, and task reporting.
README: documents node types including Team/Agent, Backlog, Approval Pool, Scheduled Trigger, and report pages with status rails and feedback annotations.
package.json: declares DSH plugin bundle/runtime UI integration and peer dependencies for dsh-agent, dsh-skill, dsh-tools, and tool adapters, indicating execution and tool-capability integration.
